subject: environmental-science

items.correct: Many sources: transport, farming, homes and waste, not just factories.
items.random_wrong: It always disappears quickly and harmlessly.
items.why: Many pollutants (plastics, nitrates, CO₂) persist and come from everyday activities.

items.q: Is nuclear power a renewable energy source?
items.correct: No — it uses finite uranium, though it is low-carbon.
items.random_wrong: Renewables produce no waste or impact at all.
items.why: Nuclear fuel runs out (non-renewable); renewables replenish but can still have impacts.
